subject: general
question:
There are four underlined words in the sentence given below. One of them is misspelt. Choose the option with the misspelt word.
Global health __experts__ warned that the next __pandemic__ could emerge from __zoonotick__ diseases __transmitted__ between animals and humans.
solution:
The correct answer is **option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**The misspelled word is 'zoonotick'.**

__
 
• **The correct spelling would be 'zoonotic'.**
 
• The word '**zoonotic**' is an **adjective** which means 'pertaining to a disease that can be transmitted from animals to humans'. **(पशुओं से मनुष्यों में फैलने वाला रोग)**
 
• **For Example -** COVID-19 is believed to be a zoonotic disease.

Therefore, the correct answer would be **'zoonotick'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Let's understand the meanings of the other marked words - **

 
• **Experts -** people who have a comprehensive and authoritative knowledge of or skill in a particular area **(विशेषज्ञ)**
 
• **Pandemic -** an outbreak of a disease prevalent over a whole country or the world **(महामारी)**
 
• **Transmitted -** caused something to pass on from one place or person to another **(संचारित)**
